verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Keychain items can be referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplicating them. Vaults are described as a single source of truth for credentials, and keys are passphrase-protected and encrypted, stored locally and synced across devices. Community comments voice general unease about storing credentials in a third-party app but give no concrete failure, so they affect confidence, not the verdict. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of credential reuse across hosts, and documented details of the vault's encryption.
